indexing.title: Indexing rules
indexing.unreadableHelp: Reload settings before changing search visibility. Existing unreadable settings will not be overwritten.
indexing.unconfirmedHelp: The change may have been saved. Your draft is kept. Reload the saved settings before saving again.
indexing.reloadFailed: The saved settings could not be read. Your draft is kept and saving stays off; reload the saved settings again.
indexing.site.title: Site-wide
indexing.site.noindexEffect: Every supported page gets noindex and nofollow. A sitemap served by this plugin lists no URLs.
indexing.site.indexEffect: Pages can appear in search results unless a rule below or the entry itself sets noindex.
indexing.site.overrideNote: Site-wide noindex overrides the content type and archive rules below. Their choices are kept and apply again when site-wide is set to Index.
indexing.precedence.description: These rules are checked in order. Any one of them keeps a page out of search results.
indexing.precedence.type: every entry of one content type.
indexing.precedence.entry: one entry, set in its editor.
indexing.precedence.optIn: An entry cannot opt back in while a rule above it applies, because its own setting can only add noindex.
indexing.help.sitemap: A sitemap served by this plugin leaves out each content type set to Noindex, keeping its choice in Sitemaps, and lists no URLs while site-wide noindex is on.
indexing.help.sitemapServed: This plugin serves this site's sitemap.
indexing.help.sitemapNotServed: This plugin does not serve this site's sitemap, so these rules do not change it.
indexing.help.archives: Archive rules never add noindex to the entries that carry these terms or change their sitemap listing. They apply only on archive templates that use this plugin's archive integration.
indexing.help.robots: Robots.txt is configured separately; these rules do not edit it.
indexing.types.title: Content types
indexing.types.effect: Noindex adds noindex to every entry of the type and leaves the type out of a sitemap served by this plugin. Index lets entries appear in search results unless an entry sets its own noindex.
indexing.types.loadFailed: Content types could not be loaded
indexing.types.unavailable: The content type list could not be read. Try again.
indexing.types.empty: No public content types were found on this site.
indexing.types.unlistedTitle: Rules for content types not on this site
indexing.types.unlistedHelp: These content types were not found. Remove any rule you no longer need.
indexing.types.unloadedHelp: Shown by name until the content types load.
indexing.archives.title: Taxonomy archives
indexing.archives.effect: Noindex adds noindex to the archive pages of every term in the taxonomy. Index lets those pages appear in search results.
indexing.archives.refreshFailed: The taxonomy list could not be refreshed
indexing.archives.unavailable: Taxonomy definitions could not be loaded. Try again.
indexing.archives.empty: No taxonomies were found on this site.
indexing.archives.truncated: Not every taxonomy is listed. Rules outside this list are kept.
indexing.archives.limitSetAll: Set all to Noindex would pass the limit of {limit}.
indexing.archives.unlistedTitle: Archive noindex rules not in this list
indexing.archives.unloadedHelp: Shown by name until the taxonomies load.
indexing.archives.truncatedHelp: They may be outside the listed taxonomies or no longer exist.
indexing.archives.unlistedHelp: No longer found on this site. Remove any you do not need.
plugin.disabled.title: {brand} is disabled
plugin.disabled.body: Enable it in EmDash Plugins to use these settings. Saved data is kept.
